# Project Plan
This project is an Electron-based AI companion that can chat (using Gemini/OpenAI API) and control computer input (keyboard and mouse). It will use a secure preload/IPC setup, a minimal modern UI, and only one package.json in the root. Keyboard/mouse control will use node packages like robotjs or nut.js. The UI will include a chat interface and controls for input automation.

Progress will be tracked in this file as each step is completed.
